focus: Drama and intrigue first: the Luka Doncic fan-ejection fallout and the Knicks-Karl-Anthony Towns extension stall lead the week. Then the biggest viral names (Steph Curry and the Warriors' win streak, Jamal Murray trade talk, Giannis and the Doc Rivers criticism) fill the rest. Every rumor is attributed and framed as a rumor. Exact stories are decided by that day's news, and no numbers or quotes are used unless they are in the sources.

long_videos.title_idea: The Trade Rumors Heating Up Right Now: Towns, Sabonis, Murray and the Teams That Might Sell
long_videos.angle: Rumor shape built as a clue chain. Open on the Knicks putting a Karl-Anthony Towns trade on the table as extension talks stall (the $276 million figure is in the headline). Then connect it to the other trade stories in the feed: Domantas Sabonis and the Kings rift, Jamal Murray and the Nuggets, and the Clippers as possible sellers. Each segment gives 2-3 attributed facts, then asks 'Now why does that matter?', then states her take as an opinion. The recap ends on one question that makes viewers pick a side. Chapters, 3-5 stories.

long_videos.title_idea: Luka, the Ejected Fan and Everyone Else Who Had a Week: The NBA Feuds Nobody Dropped
long_videos.angle: Beef shape, 3-5 connected stories. Lead with the Luka Doncic and ejected Kings fan story: the wife's side, and how fans reacted. Then add the other feuds in the feed: Nick Young calling out Giannis amid Doc Rivers' criticism, the NBA announcer and the Ayesha Curry movie scene backlash, and the Robert Williams and Lakers official confrontation. Each segment follows receipt, then BUT (the other side or the silence), then SO (why it stings), then her take. Where outlets disagree or one side has not responded, say so plainly. Finish with a recap and a 'whose side are you on' question.

shorts_themes: Luka and the ejected fan: the wife's side of the story, told from the middle of the moment, ending on a pick-a-side question

Ayesha Curry movie scene backlash and the announcer who fired back
Lighter closer of the day: Tyler Kolek and the Taylor Swift comment, or any harmless fan or player moment
series: Trade Board: a recurring rumor short that ranks or tracks one team's situation, using only reported facts
Receipts: the beef shape in 30 seconds, with the exact quote or action attributed
Clue Chain: 2-3 real facts laid out one at a time, ending on 'Now why would they do that?'
